title: Celestica Announces Equity Offering of 9,677,419 Shares
text:
Celestica, a technology leader in data center infrastructure and advanced technology solutions, announces the pricing of its equity offering of 9,677,419 common shares at a price to the public of $310 per share. The gross proceeds from the Offering are expected to be $3 billion.
Celestica, a global leader in data center infrastructure and advanced technology solutions, announces the pricing of its equity offering of 9,677,419 common shares at $310 per share.
The gross proceeds from the Offering are expected to be $3 billion. The Offering is expected to close on or about August 7, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. BofA Securities and Citigroup are acting as joint lead bookrunners, and TD Securities is acting as bookrunner for the Offering. Celestica uses the net proceeds from the Offering for working capital and investments in capital expenditures, in addition to other general corporate purposes
